Christmas pop-ups and events in Amsterdam

All this week's events

Christmas in Amsterdam is less one big market than a string of short-run pop-ups: markets, winter terraces, workshops and light walks. Some pop ups last a weekend, others run all season. Here are the one-off and limited-run ones from now to early January, if you want ideas for a spontaneous evening out. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go. Looking only for markets? See our Christmas markets page. For New Year's Eve, see our New Year's Eve pop-ups page.

18 events, listed by date.

Map of the events

Showing today onwards

  1. Het Amsterdamse Winterterras

    Food · Drink · Music · Kids & Family

    When
    Fri–Sun, 13–29 Nov (three weekends), Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat 14:00–23:00, Sun 14:00–22:00
    Where
    NDSM-loods, NDSM-Plein 27, Amsterdam (NDSM, Noord)
    Price
    Tickets; kids under 12 free
    Organiser
    Het Amsterdamse Winterterras

    Weekend two of a covered winter terrace inside a dome in the NDSM shipyard hall — Amsterdam restaurants and bars under one roof, DJs and sing-alongs, plus a mini-terrace for kids.

    Details and tickets for Het Amsterdamse Winterterras (organiser's site)

    Food

    When
    Fridays & Saturdays, 13 Nov – 23 Jan (not 25–26 Dec or 1 Jan), Start between 17:00 and 19:00

    Starts at Vermeers Wijnkamer, Zeedijk 11, Amsterdam (Centrum)
    Price

  5. Amsterdam Light Festival — Edition 15

    Art & Design · Kids & Family

    When
    Thu 26 Nov 2026 – Sun 17 Jan 2027, Lights 16:30–23:00 (31 Dec until 21:00)
    Where
    Walking route through the city centre (info point at Amstel 1 / Waterlooplein 6, Amsterdam) (Centrum)
    Price
    The 4.5 km route is in public space; paid app, guided walks and cruises sold separately
    Organiser
    Amsterdam Light Festival

    The fifteenth Amsterdam Light Festival places new light artworks above, beside and in the canals, from late November to mid-January. Walk the 4.5 km route yourself, or book a guided walk or cruise. On 26 November, 12 and 19 December the route also has Light Nights, with pop-up performances and storytellers.

    Details and tickets for Amsterdam Light Festival — Edition 15 (organiser's site)

  6. Amsterdam Light Festival — Light Nights

    Art & Design · Kids & Family

    When
    26 Nov, 12 & 19 Dec, From late afternoon into the evening; programme times vary
    Where
    Along the Light Festival route, city centre, Amsterdam (Centrum)
    Price
    Many programme items are on the route; some tours and workshops need a ticket
    Organiser
    Amsterdam Light Festival

    Three evenings when the Light Festival route gets extra life: pop-up performances, storytellers near the artworks, a kids' puzzle trail, talks and a handful of ticketed tours and workshops. The first Light Night, on 26 November, is also the opening of Edition 15.

    Details and tickets for Amsterdam Light Festival — Light Nights (organiser's site)
